craft_notes: Sthāyin: quiescence deepening (the senses set). Sanskrit first: setting (sense-host set, standing without), condition (she dissolved in supreme) → L4 sets setting line 1, condition line 2. Rows: row 3 (then/when correlative — 'then/when' kept). Rupture: comma after 'outside' — world done, goddess begins. Close: end-weight on the verb ('dissolves' — the whole verse leans into it). Minimal pass: 'sense-herd' for grāma (village-as-herd singable, same collective); 'melts' refused for 'dissolves' (līna is dissolved, kept). Read aloud: line 1 sunsets (sets/stands/outside falling), line 2 stills (supreme/dissolves long). Rejected: 'the senses sleep' — killed: astamita is set (sun-metaphor), sleep imports night; 'merges' — killed: dissolve is texture, merge is diplomacy.

lines: Then the whole sense-herd sets and stands outside,
when she, the supreme power, in the supreme dissolves.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadā tv astamitaṃ sarvamakṣagrāmaṃ bahiḥ sthitam / yadā sā paramā śaktiḥ sulīnā parame pade

reads_against.argmap: In repose the whole outer sense-host sets; she lies well dissolved in the supreme state.
c1_essence: The sign-list resolves: final state declared; rest taught next.
